highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 moves onto Skia m151 and ports several hot paths to allocation-free managed C#.
highlights_body: A batch of performance PRs move color conversion, premultiply math, and HarfBuzz/font-tag parsing off native round-trips and onto zero-allocation managed code, plus new .NET 11 WASM support.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled Skia engine to m151 and folds in several rounds of upstream bug fixes merged during the preview cycle.
SKColor↔SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, SKColor hex parsing, and SKShaper glyph reads move to allocation-free managed implementations with new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads.
Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now pools its UTF-8 encode, and Tag.Parse/SKFourByteTag.Parse no longer allocate a char[4] per call.

bullets.lead: Native resource and CPU-raster regressions fixed
bullets.detail: SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks a native resource, unnecessary unsafe was dropped from GRContextOptions, and a legacy shader-context flag was restored to fix a CPU raster regression.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 and a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions early.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bumped the externals/skia submodule and added the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries for .NET 11

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Opened the 4.151.0 line by bumping Skia to milestone m151.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Landed the bulk of the managed performance rewrites: color conversion, premultiply math, hex parsing, HarfBuzz buffer/tag parsing, and SKShaper span reads.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Added .NET 11 WASM support and a WASM exception-handling test job, plus a CPU raster regression fix, ahead of the stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Ships allocation-free Buffer.AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse implementations alongside the m151 engine bump.
